hooks.prompt: You are about to write or edit a file. If this file is inside a `pages/` directory, STOP and check: have ALL child components listed in the decomposition completed their full build cycle? Specifically, each component must have: (a) companion files created — .test.tsx, .visual.spec.ts, __fixtures__/*.fixture.ts, (b) unit tests executed and passing, (c) visual comparison test executed with ≥ 99% pixel similarity. If ANY component is missing files or has not had its tests run successfully, do NOT write the page file — go back and complete that component first.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | xargs -I{} pnpm eslint --no-warn-ignored --max-warnings=0 {} 2>&1 || true
echo '--- Lint + typecheck ---' && pnpm lint 2>&1 | tail -20 && pnpm typecheck 2>&1 | tail -20
